Spellcasting. The mage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The mage has the following wizard spells prepared:

Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation

1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield

2nd level (3 slots): misty step, suggestion

3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly

4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm

5th level (1 slot): cone of cold, arcane whisper

Innate Spellcasting. The djinni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, thunderwave

3/day each: create food and water, tongues, wind walk

1/day each: conjure elemental, creation, gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift

Spellcasting. The lich casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mage Hand}, Detect Magic, Prestidigitation

2/Day Each: Animate Dead, Dimension Door, Plane Shift

1/Day Each: Chain Lightning, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFingerOfDea]{Finger of Death}, Power Word Kill, Soul Siphon

Incantation innée. La caractéristique d'incantation innée du sorcier est le Charisme (DD du jet de sauvegarde des sorts 15, +7 au toucher avec les attaques de sort). Il peut lancer les sorts suivants, sans composante matérielle :

À volonté : détection de la magie, main de mage

3/jour chacun : boule de feu, vol

1/jour chacun : image majeure

Incantation. Le magicien est un lanceur de sorts de niveau 5. Sa caractéristique d'incantation est l'Intelligence (DD du jet de sauvegarde des sorts 14, +6 au toucher avec les attaques de sort). Sorts de magicien préparés :

Sorts mineurs (à volonté) : trait de feu, lumière

Niveau 1 (4 emplacements) : bouclier, projectile magique

Niveau 2 (3 emplacements) : image miroir

Spellcasting. The warlock uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks):

At Will: Minor Illusion, Disguise Self

2/Day Each: Hold Person, Fear, Hex Whisper

1/Day Each: Haste, Dispel Magic
